description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Filter items based on item_applicability. Possible values are : all, restricted.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → item_applicability[is_not] = "all"

is.description: \* \`all\` - all addon-items and charge-items are applicable to this plan-item. \* \`restricted\` - only the addon-items or charge-items provided in `applicable_items` can be applied to this plan-item.

is_not.description: \* \`all\` - all addon-items and charge-items are applicable to this plan-item. \* \`restricted\` - only the addon-items or charge-items provided in `applicable_items` can be applied to this plan-item.
